# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published `0.1.x` release and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for `rock3r/pioneer`. Do not open a public issue for suspected sandbox escapes, credential disclosure, proxy bypasses, or unsafe path grants.

Include the operating system and version, Pioneer version, reproduction steps, expected boundary, and observed behavior. Remove provider credentials, copied Pi state, proxy tokens, and private source content from every report.

The project will acknowledge a complete report as soon as practical, validate the affected boundary, and coordinate disclosure after a fix or documented mitigation is available.

See [the security model](../docs/SECURITY.md) for guarantees, trust boundaries, and residual risks.
